title: Ubusitani Bugenda Bushira bw'Uburumbuke
intro: Mu gihugu cyari gifite ubutunzi bwinshi, umuryango warateye imbere, ubaho hagati y’ibimenyetso by’ubuntu bw’Imana. Uburumbuke bwabo bwari igihamya cy’ubuntu bw’Imana yabo, impano yari igamije kubatera gushima no kumvira. Nyamara, nubwo hari ibimenyetso by’imigisha yabo bigaragara, hari impinduka yageze aho, ibagerageza ku bw’agaciro bafitiye isoko y’ubutunzi bwabo bwinshi n’ihumure.
clues: Twahawe umugisha wo kugira ubusitani bubiri, bumwe iburyo n'ubundi ibumoso, bwuzuye umusaruro.
Twategetswe kurya ku byo Umwami wacu yatugabiye no kumushimira ku bw'igihugu cyiza n'Imana ibabarira.
Twatangiye kwishyira hejuru maze tuva mu nzira yo gushima, twirata ubutunzi bwacu n'ububasha bwacu.
Twasabye ko Umwami wacu yongerera intera iri hagati y'ingendo zacu, tugaragaza ko twanze ubworoherane yari yaduhaye.
Twaburiwe n'intumwa, ariko twanze ubutumwa maze dukomeza kwirengagiza.
Urugomero rwacu rukomeye, rwadufashije gukomeza iterambere ryacu, rwasenyutse, bituma havuka umwuzure ukaze cyane.

outcome.answer: Twaratatanye kandi ubutaka bwacu bwahindutse ubutayu

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
